## Earshot {{VERSION}}

Your realme Buds Air 6 Pro in the menu bar: battery for each bud and the case, and one-click noise control.

### Install

1. Download **Earshot.dmg** below, open it, and drag Earshot to Applications.
2. Open Earshot. It's free and not notarized by Apple, so macOS asks first: click **Done**, then go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.
   (Or in Terminal: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Earshot.app`)
3. Allow Bluetooth when asked, and connect your buds.

Requires macOS 14 or later. Universal: Apple silicon and Intel.
`Earshot.dmg.sha256` holds the DMG's SHA-256 checksum.
